verdict.rationale: YYLO is a coding-agent orchestrator, so automatically fixing failing agent-readiness criteria is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no such capability. The closest feature, `doctor workspace`, only reports topology problems and explicitly never changes the workspace. That is an adjacent diagnostic, not automatic remediation of agent-readiness criteria.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can automatically fix failing agent-readiness criteria in my repository
